semantic_review_notes: Opt-in QA renderer exports real Customer components across locale/theme/brand-color permutations for Issue #338 visual comparison. Uses production providers/components and writes only when QA338_RENDER is explicitly set.
invariants_error_checks: covers valid primary colors plus fallback
test_refs: production components imported directly by the renderer
limits: QA artifact generator rather than runtime code; file output path is operator-supplied.

semantic_review_notes: Verifies pre-hydration document bootstrap applies persisted Arabic RTL/dark theme before React hydration, defaults unsupported values to English/light, updates theme-color metadata, and is installed through Next beforeInteractive.
invariants_error_checks: unsupported persisted values fail to safe defaults
limits: Tests presentation preference storage only; no guest credential/session data is persisted by this bootstrap.

semantic_review_notes: Mounted root test proves completed-session rating is exposed only after latest authority revalidation and blocks entry under absent client, incomplete/unavailable bootstrap, context switching/ambiguity/conflict, expired/network/stale session states. Opening does not submit a rating.
limits: Auth/session hooks are mocked but root wiring and mounted behavior are real.

semantic_review_notes: Mounted refresh regressions cover manual-refresh coalescing, overlap with scheduled polling, recovery from temporary initial failure, client-context replacement fencing, and prevention of stale-notice refresh while Request Vehicle mutation is pending.
invariants_error_checks: fast duplicate refresh does not add GET
late Visit A response cannot repaint Visit B
no read races pending retrieval mutation
limits: Mounted fake DOM with fetch mocks; no live server execution.

semantic_review_notes: Validates production Web Push permission card mounts only for an authoritative pre-READY visit when both caller gate and server policy flag are affirmative; missing/false policy or READY session suppresses the prompt. Also asserts the mount follows freshness handling in the live root.
limits: Static-render gate test; browser Push API behavior is covered elsewhere.

semantic_review_notes: Readiness concurrency coverage validates 100-call coalescing, no permanent cache, bounded timeout even if fetch ignores abort, 128-waiter cap, stale success rejection after artifact API origin changes, and generic/no-store route responses.
invariants_error_checks: single upstream probe for matching concurrent callers
hung probe resolves false by deadline
limits: Concurrency is unit-level; real process/network saturation is not exercised.

semantic_review_notes: Readiness route tests pin the build artifact API origin, ignore runtime API_ORIGIN override, enforce no-store GET with redirect:error, fail closed for unreachable/not-ready/malformed-origin cases, bound hung transports, and expose only generic unavailable state.
invariants_error_checks: origin must be exact origin without path/userinfo
response body leaks no upstream detail
limits: Tests mocked fetch; TLS/DNS behavior is outside scope.

semantic_review_notes: Mounted accessibility contract for stacked BottomSheets: only topmost handles Escape/Tab, focus is trapped/wrapped from inside and outside, disabled controls are skipped in LTR/RTL, and focus is not restored to a trigger removed while open.
limits: Custom fake DOM models focus behavior; native browser accessibility tree is not exercised.

semantic_review_notes: Presentation tests preserve pickup PIN digit order with explicit LTR inside Arabic RTL, QR scan contrast independent of theme, accessible More button, and one localized dark-mode switch with proper aria state in both locales.
limits: Static markup presentation coverage; QR decode reliability is covered by matrix/QR tests elsewhere.

semantic_review_notes: Guest bootstrap rate-limit tests cover authoritative Retry-After handling including overflow, one deferred retry at the exact PREPARE/EXCHANGE/RECONCILE_SWITCH stage, lost exchange response reconciliation, long-window explicit retry eligibility, context-generation fencing, terminal invalid bearer clearing, and preservation of explicit context-switch intent without immediate replay.
limits: Fake timers/fetch mocks; server limiter semantics are not asserted here.

semantic_review_notes: Mounted GuestAuthProvider tests prove fragment credentials are scrubbed immediately, one short 429 is deferred then transitions to cookie authority, context change cancels pending replay, and a long Retry-After remains explicit/scheduled and is canceled if authority changes.
limits: Mounted fake DOM/fake timers; cookie is represented by browser-session client behavior rather than a live Set-Cookie exchange.

semantic_review_notes: Context-switch state tests distinguish SAME_VISIT continuity from ACTIVE/POST_VISIT conflict, retry only ambiguous switch outcomes once, preserve current authority while an explicit switch is pending/ambiguous, and discard only the invalid new-link intent on definitive denial.
invariants_error_checks: same visit adopts cookie authority without conflict
conflicting bearer stays memory-only pending decision
ambiguous failure preserves current client and pending intent
limits: Transport behavior is mocked; server-side switch atomicity is outside this file.

semantic_review_notes: Bootstrap tests cover deterministic SSR/first-render state, legacy bearer mode when enrollment is disabled, prepare→exchange→cookie authority when enabled, cookie-only restore, retry classification, one replay for ambiguous exchange failure, exact-stage recovery, and fail-closed behavior after invalid authority.
invariants_error_checks: first render does not inspect fragment
400/401/429 exchange not blindly retried by ambiguous-recovery path
invalid exchange has no legacy fallback
limits: Primarily transport/state tests with mocked fetch.

semantic_review_notes: Fragment adapter tests enforce exact 43-character base64url credential shape, browser-only extraction, immediate history.replaceState scrub preserving path/query, malformed/extra-content rejection, fail-closed adoption when scrub fails, and no interference with unrelated hashes.
invariants_error_checks: credential never adopted before successful scrub
limits: History API is stubbed; browser referrer/history edge behavior is not live-tested here.

semantic_review_notes: Conflict overlay tests verify approved ACTIVE/POST_VISIT messaging in EN/AR, LTR/RTL, disabled implicit decisions while switch outcome is ambiguous, and gating that waits for an authoritative current snapshot while preserving the last snapshot only during ambiguity.
invariants_error_checks: no conflict UI before current snapshot exists
limits: Presentation/state-gate coverage; explicit switch transport is tested separately.

semantic_review_notes: Guest information presentation renders only published privacy text/URL and returned contact fields, uses safe external-link rel attributes, preserves line breaks, and presents localized unavailable states without inventing policy/contact facts.
limits: Trusts the contract/API to validate supportUrl/phone syntax before rendering.

semantic_review_notes: Mounted More-menu information flow preserves approved rows, removes Photos, opens privacy/contact in a single-dialog transition with focus restoration, fences an old visit information response after credential-client replacement, and retries read failure only on explicit user action.
invariants_error_checks: old-client result cannot repaint new client
limits: Mounted fake DOM; server authorization/tenant binding is assumed from GuestApiClient/API.

semantic_review_notes: Regression test confirms bottom navigation/Help/tab routes and Photos row remain removed in production/development while Payment and Rating stay as independent preview surfaces; Rating Done returns to Completed.
invariants_error_checks: More rows localized and Photos absent
limits: Partially source-string based architectural regression check.

semantic_review_notes: Demo registry contract enforces five approved groups, unique IDs, valid EN/AR label keys, removal of legacy duplicated Arabic screens, and a strict kind split between live, screens, and the three approved overlays.
limits: Dev-preview-only registry.
